s.n: All' ombra degli abeti
P02 - Cossogno - Pizzo Pernice
s.nota: From Cossogno amidst chestnut on the ancient cobbled mule track to Alpe Rugno, then for the meadows of high pastures and finally the long panoramic ridge that culminates at Pizzo Pernice

s.n: P08 - Cicogna -Tregugno - la Soliva - Pian Cavallone
s.a: bivio R03 presso Colle della Forcola
s.nota: A challenging path for complexity, development and difficulty, the path from la Soliva to the Forcola Saddle is on steep meadows and You crosse a valley with vertical rocky walls supported by the chains

s.n: Sentiero BOVE tratto Cicogna - Pian Cavallone
s.nota: Tough route for steep slopes to go up, but no technical difficulty, even marks, albeit sometimes distant, are present throughout the path and the trace is always visible

s.n: R03 - Sentiero BOVE tratto Pian Cavallone Monte Zeda
s.nota: Panoramic path along the ridge that from Pian Cavallone leads first to Pizzo Marona and then to Monte Zeda

s.n: Alpe Varola - Fontan Gemelle - Corte Morgin
s.nota: Similar to its lower twin P06a but more tiring and hard to find because unmarked. To make a ring it is advisable to follow it on the way and return to P06a

s.n: Alpe Varola - Corte Morgin
s.nota: Path for lovers of solitude in the beech woods of the Val Pobbie. Corte Morgin at the confluence of three rivers is a pleasant surprise on a sunny coast still rich in meadows.

s.n: P06 - Cicogna - Varola - Curgei - Pizzo Pernice
s.nota: Tough route for steep slopes to go up, but no technical difficulty, even marks, albeit sometimes distant, are present throughout the path and the trace is always visible

s.n: R00 Verbania Intra P.le Flaim - Trobaso - Cambiasca - Caprezzo - Intragna - Aurano
s.nota: From Verbania Intra P.le Flaim through Trobaso,Cambiasca,Caprezzo,Intragna to Aurano, crossroad with R8,R14,R15. Long path that enters the uncontaminated Valle Intrasca of the San Giovanni torrent, adjoining the Val Grande National Park.

s.n: R14 Aurano - Luera
s.nota: The route starts from Aurano, crosses some little valleys to reach the Alpe Erbia and then, with a flat path, reaches Luera, crossroads the R10, R12, R18, R22 routes.

s.n: R03 Cambiasca - Pian Cavallone - Pizzo Marona - Monte Zeda
s.nota: Route of great landscape interest that goes from Cambiasca to Monte Zeda passing from the peak of Pizzo Marona; it crosses Miazzina,Alpe Pala,Cappella Fina,Pian Cavallone,Colle Forcola,Passo del Diavolo,Pizzo Marona. Exposed stretch with chains.

s.n: R07 Intragna - Cappella del Pian Cavallone
s.a: Cappella del Pian Cavallone - bivio R03 (m 1544)
s.nota: In very open environment between Intragna and the Rifugio Pian Cavallone CAI Verbano,through Cambiesso and Sunfaì along the route of the Valle Intrasca Marathon.Continuing on R03,near the ruined of ex-hotel,there is the winter bivouac always open.

s.n: R05 Caprezzo - Pian Cavallone bivio R07
s.nota: The route connects Caprezzo to the R07 crossroads just below the CAI refuge at Pian Cavallone. From Caprezzo, climbing to the Mon Rous and Ad Vel pastures, you reach Cappella Porta, then, in a beech and fir wood, climb to the CAI Verbano refuge.

s.n: R03a Cappella Fina bivio R03 - Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala
s.a: Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala (m 1200)
s.nota: Connection route between Cappella Fina (crossroads R03) and crossroads with R05 Cappella Porta-Cornala. Useful for the R03-R05 ring route through Pian Cavallone. Some large part of the route on a wide dirt road and part on path. Some small stream fords.

s.n: R09 Intragna - Onunchio - Colle della Forcola
s.nota: Intragna and pasture Corpetto, Doaglia, Usciago, Casaiuva, Onunchio, Colle della Forcola. A path in the San Giovanni Valley on practicable and signposted paths up to Onunchio, then less obvious signs with some demanding passages.

s.n: R11 Scareno - Alpe Piaggia - Passo Folungo
s.nota: Scareno, Ponte del Dragone, Alpe Piaggia, Corte Bavarone, Passo Folungo. Before Corte Bavarone di Sotto pay attention to the descent on Rio Scogno where the bridge also collapsed, ford to cross the stream.

s.n: R13 Scareno - Pian d'Arla
s.nota: The route connects Scareno to Pian d'Arla (crossroads R10) passing through the pastures Ca Rod, La Rocca and Sassello (crossroads R13a).

s.n: R15 Aurano - Calpera - il Colle
s.nota: The route connects Aurano passing through its numerous ancient Courts and Pastures (Giovanoli, Segletta connected by a short detour, Caramelli, Laveggio, Calpera) to il Colle, a crossroads of numerous other routes coming from all directions.

s.n: R15a Bivio R15 Alpe Segletta - Piancavallo
s.da: Bivio R15 Alpe Segletta (sud di Corte Giovanoli) (m 920)
s.nota: The route starts from the crossroads with the R15 at Alpe Segletta (beginning south of Corte Giovanoli), along a stretch of carriage road, a stretch of dirt road, then on a path to reach Piancavallo.

s.n: R09a Corpetto - Bivio R11 Cappella sopra Ponte del Dragone
s.a: Bivio R11 - Cappella sopra Ponte del Dragone (m 735)
s.nota: From the mountain pasture of Corpetto near Intragna go down to the Usciago Fondo bridge over the San Giovanni stream to go up to the crossroads with R11 to the Chapel above the Ponte del Dragone in the direction of Piaggia.

s.n: R07a Cambiesso - Cappella Porta
s.nota: From Cambiesso to Cappella Porta passing by Corte Steppio, still loaded with animals in summer and with some well-kept huts, and then by the old pastures of Pechi-Campale, Gajin and Fai. Numerous fords. Some passages exposed but equipped

s.n: km verticale Intragna
XR1A - Steppio - La Piazza
s.nota: Discovering an ancient path connecting Steppio and la Piazza that winds through abandoned locality and lush beech forests

s.n: XR1B - Bivio R07 - Steppio
s.da: Bivio R07 presso ultimo tornante strada
s.nota: Route recently completely refurbished and used as preferential access to Steppio
